questions.question: What word exposed the fleeing Ephraimites at the Jordan?
Why could the Ephraimites not say the word correctly?
options: They spoke a completely different language
They stayed silent out of fear
They deliberately lied about their tribe
They could not pronounce the "sh" sound
questions.answer: They could not pronounce the "sh" sound

questions.question: The men of Gilead under Jephthah fought against the tribe of Ephraim.
Those who could not pronounce "_____" correctly were identified and killed.
This chapter also lists minor judges, including Ibzan, Elon, and _____.
